nousresearch/hermes-agent.caption:
6 AI agents, compared in under 2 minutes. 

Three run in someone else’s cloud. Three are open source. And one of them is something else entirely.

🟣 Dots (OpenAI): an always-on worker inside ChatGPT. Give it an ongoing goal and it keeps going in the background.

🔵 Muse (Meta): the personal one. Book
